# HIS Project Summary — `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\tam-duc\his`

> **Lưu ý workspace:** Repo hiện chỉ chứa project web `his/`. `Web.config`, `bin/`, và các project tham chiếu (`InformationWebObject`, `CRMObject`, …) **không có trong workspace** — chỉ thấy qua `.csproj`. Không có `.cursor/rules`, `AGENTS.md`, hay README.

---

## 1. Project type & tech stack

| Item | Fact from codebase |
|------|-------------------|
| **Type** | ASP.NET Web Forms website (Hospital Information System / CMS frontend) |
| **Project** | `InformationWeb` — `RootNamespace`: `InformationWeb`, `AssemblyName`: `InformationWeb` |
| **Framework** | **.NET Framework 4.0** (`TargetFrameworkVersion` v4.0, `ToolsVersion` 4.0) |
| **VS** | `.csproj` tương thích VS2010; `InformationWeb.sln` ghi **Visual Studio 17** (môi trường build thực tế có thể VS mới hơn) |
| **IIS** | `UseIISExpress=false`; dev port cũ: `45232` |
| **Domain** | Primary: `tamduchearthospital.com`; secondary redirect 301 → primary: `benhvientimtamduc.com` |

**Libraries (from `InformationWeb.csproj`):**
- **UI:** Telerik Web UI **2010.3.1312.40**, AjaxControlToolkit 4.1, CommonControls
- **Core:** `DCore.dll` (ConfigManager, Globals, Cryptography)
- **Data/objects:** Project refs → `InformationWebObject`, `CRMObject`, `TKSObject`, `SystemObject`
- **Services:** `CRMService`, `TKSService`, `SystemService`, `WebGlobal`
- **Other:** `Libs.dll` (HTTP API), Newtonsoft.Json.Net20, HtmlAgilityPack, CollectionPager, UrlRewritingNet.UrlRewriter, SystemManagement/SystemMenu (+ Object DLLs)
- **Payment (legacy ref):** PayooBusinessAPI, PayooDotNet2xSDK — chỉ thấy chuỗi resource, không thấy code dùng trong `his/`

**Không có:** Crystal Reports, Aspose, RDLC trong codebase `his/`.

---

## 2. Solution / project structure

### Solution
- `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\tam-duc\his\InformationWeb.sln` — **chỉ 1 project** `InformationWeb`

### Project references (expected sibling folders `..\`, **not in workspace**)
```
..\CRMObject\CRMObject.csproj
..\CRMService\CRMService.csproj
..\InformationWebObject\InformationWebObject.csproj
..\SystemObject\SystemObject.csproj
..\SystemService\SystemService.csproj
..\TKSObject\TKSObject.csproj
..\TKSService\TKSService.csproj
..\WebGlobal\WebGlobal.csproj
```

### Kiến trúc thực tế (không phải BLL/DAL folder trong repo)

```
Presentation (his/)
  ├── *.aspx / *.Master / Controls/*.ascx / *.ashx
  ├── Utility/          → ResManager, WebGlobal wrapper, SecurityHelper, NotFoundHelper
  └── Global.asax.cs

Object layer (DLL – InformationWebObject, CRMObject, …)
  └── INFO_Information, SYS_Counter, CRM_Booking, ITEM_Product …
      └── .GetDataTable("StoredProc", "@Param", value, …)
      └── .Get() / .GetByLink() / .Add() / .Update()

Core (DCore.dll)
  └── ConfigManager.GetConfig(), Globals.ApplicationVRoot

External APIs
  └── DOMAIN_CMS_API + SEC_CMS_API (booking, doctor list)
  └── OpenAI (chatbot)
```

### Top-level folders trong `his/`

| Folder | Role |
|--------|------|
| `Controls/` | User controls theo domain (InformationSection, API, Comment, Contact, …) |
| `Pages/InfoSection/` | Trang nội dung (detail, list, booking, search, landing) |
| `Pages/Search/` | Search legacy |
| `Utility/` | ResManager, WebGlobal, Variables, SecurityHelper |
| `App_GlobalResources/` | `Lang.resx` (VI), `LangEn.resx` (EN) |
| `App_Themes/Default/` | CSS hospital-specific (`custom-hos-*`, booking, mobile nav) |
| `assets/` | Bootstrap, jQuery, Slick, main JS/CSS |
| `assetsLangding/` | Landing page theme assets |
| `App_Data/ChatLogs/` | Chat query logs |
| `urlrewrite.config` | SEO-friendly URL rules |

---

## 3. Naming conventions

### Files & classes
- **Namespace:** `InformationWeb`, `InformationWeb.Controls.InformationSection`, `InformationWeb.Pages.InfoSection`, `InformationWeb.Utility`
- **Pages:** `InfoSectionDetailRouter.aspx.cs`, `Booking.aspx.cs`
- **Controls:** `SectionDoctor.ascx`, `InfoSectionList3.ascx` (+ `.designer.cs` auto)
- **Master:** `BDS.Master` (main), `DANGKY.Master` (registration theme), `Landing.Master` (landing động)
- **Handlers:** `ChatApi.ashx`, `Sitemap.ashx`

### Code style (legacy Vietnamese CMS)
- **Hungarian + camelCase:** `strTitle`, `dtbData`, `lngInfoID`, `bolSuccess`, `intTitleLenMin`
- **Entity classes:** prefix module — `INFO_Information`, `INFO_Category`, `SYS_Department`, `SYS_Counter`, `CRM_Booking`, `ITEM_Product`, `EXT_LocationContent`, `HRS_Area` (commented)
- **Methods:** PascalCase — `LoadIDForInformation`, `GetDataTable`, `TransferToNotFound`
- **Properties public on controls:** `CategoryID`, `MobileNavActive`

### Database / stored procedures
- **Proc naming:** `{Module}_{Entity}_{Action}` — e.g. `INFO_Information_HOS_News`, `HOS_NewsDetail2_GetDetail`, `INFO_Information_Doctor`, `INFO_Chat_GET_ByKeyword`, `CRM` via API not direct SQL in web
- **Parameters:** `@LanguageID`, `@InformationLink`, `@NodeID`, `@Top`, `@Slug`, `@CategoryIds`
- **Language:** `1` = Vietnamese (default), `2` = English
- **Category IDs (hardcoded):** e.g. root doctor `305`, news `125`, FAQ `352`, CBT `374`, home sections in `Home.ascx.cs`
- **Image paths:** `Information{000000}` padding 6 digits — `WebGlobal.InformationThumbDirectory`

### URLs (SEO slugs)
- Vietnamese kebab-case: `/tin-tuc/`, `/bac-si/`, `/dat-lich-kham`, `/doi-ngu-chuyen-gia`, `/tim-kiem`
- EN prefix: `/en/...` + query `lang=en` from urlrewrite

---

## 4. Key patterns

### Master pages
- **`BDS.Master`** — layout chính: Header, Footer, ChatWidget, SEO (og:*, canonical, JSON-LD Article), mobile bottom nav, `ToolkitScriptManager`
- **`BDS.Master.cs`** — parse URL → set `Variables.Url_*`, load SEO by slug/iid, domain redirect
- **`DANGKY.Master`** — Bootstrap 5 theme riêng (`/New_Bootstrap5/`)
- **`Landing.Master`** — landing CMS tối giản, không dùng BDS

### User controls
- Trang chủ (`Home.ascx`) **dynamic-load** sections theo `INFO_Category_GetHomeSections` + map `CategoryID → control path`
- Detail có nhiều layout: `InfoSectionDetail`, `Detail2`, `Detail3` (doctor), `Detail4`, `Detail5` (preview CMS)
- **`InfoSectionDetailRouter.aspx`** — route theo `InformationTypeID` (type 7 → layout full)

### Routing
- **`urlrewrite.config`** + **UrlRewritingNet** (`rewriteOnlyVirtualUrls="true"`, `defaultPage="Default.aspx"`)
- Block spam extensions/folders, ignore static assets
- Detail news → `InfoSectionDetailRouter.aspx?slug=…&cate=…`
- Doctor → `InfoSectionDetail3.aspx?slug=…`
- Booking → `Booking.aspx`; API rewrite `~/api/*` → `~/api/forbooking/*.ashx` (handler ngoài workspace)

### Localization
- **`ResManager`** (`Utility/ResourceManager.cs`): session key `Current_Language`, default `1`
- Resources: `App_GlobalResources/Lang.resx`, `LangEn.resx` — access via `ResManager.GetString("Key")`
- **`Language.ascx`:** set `CurrentLanguageID`, redirect `/en` or `/`
- EN content columns: `TitleEn`, `ContentEn`, `CategoryNameEn` when `CurrentLanguageID == 2`
- Urlrewrite thêm `?lang=en`; **không thấy handler đọc `Request["lang"]` trong `his/`** — có thể nằm trong DCore/WebGlobal DLL

### Session / request state
- **`Variables`** class: `Url_InfoID`, `Url_CateID`, `Url_InfoTypeID`, `Url_DepartmentID`, `Url_SubUrl`
- Legacy aliases: `Session["id"]`, `["nid"]`, `["tid"]`
- Query params: `slug`, `iid`, `clink`, `dlink`, `tlink`, `cate`

### Caching
- `Page.Cache` / `HttpRuntime.Cache` với keys như `INFO_LIST3_CATE_{lang}`, TTL 3–10 phút

### Error handling
- **`NotFoundHelper.TransferToNotFound()`** → `Server.Transfer("~/NotFound.aspx")`
- **`MessageManager.ShowErrorMessage`** (CommonControls) cho booking errors

---

## 5. Database access patterns

**Không có ADO.NET trực tiếp trong `his/`** — tất cả qua object DLL:

```csharp
INFO_Information info = new INFO_Information();
DataTable dt = info.GetDataTable(
    "INFO_Information_HOS_NewsM",
    "@LanguageID", languageID,
    "@NodeID", nodeID,
    "@Top", top
);
```

**CRUD pattern on entities:**
```csharp
SYS_Counter item = new SYS_Counter();
item.Counter = ...;
item.ID = ...;
item.Update(); // or item.Add();
item.Get(); item.GetByLink();
```

**Config / connection:**
- **`DCore.ConfigManager.GetConfig("Key")`** — majority of app settings (paths, page sizes, API keys)
- **`ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Key"]`** — SEO, chat, contact, advertisement
- **Connection strings:** expected in missing `Web.config` (not readable)

**Booking:** không gọi SP trực tiếp (commented `HRS_Employee_*`); dùng **REST CMS API**:
- `GET {DOMAIN_CMS_API}/api/DoctorList`
- `GET …/api/DoctorFreeDates`
- `POST …/api/AddBooking` with `x-api-key: SEC_CMS_API`

**Chat RAG:**
- `INFO_Information_GET_Chat`, `INFO_Chat_GET_ByKeyword` + OpenAI API

---

## 6. JavaScript / CSS conventions

### JavaScript
- **Main site (`BDS.Master`):** jQuery **3.6.0**, Bootstrap, Slick, Swiper, Magnific Popup, jQuery UI — scripts **defer**
- **`assets/js/main.js`:** IIFE `(function ($) { "use strict"; … }`, **no ES6 arrows** in pattern
- **`chatbot.js`:** vanilla JS IIFE, `"use strict"`, `fetch`/XHR POST to `ChatApi.ashx`, localStorage history key `hos_chat_history_v1`
- **DANGKY.Master:** jQuery 3.6 + Bootstrap 5 bundle (mixed CDN + local)

### CSS
- Global: `/assets/css/style.css`, Bootstrap
- Hospital overrides: `/App_Themes/Default/custom-hos-*.css`, `zboooking.css`, `info-section-detail.css`, `mobile-bottom-nav.css`
- **Prefix classes:** `hos-` (e.g. `hos-mbn`, `hos-chat__*`), CSS vars `--hos-green`
- Chat: `Controls/InformationSection/Information/chatbot.css`
- Fonts: Inter, Open Sans, Montserrat (Google Fonts); Boxicons

---

## 7. Important domain areas

| Area | Key files | Notes |
|------|-----------|-------|
| **Home / sections** | `Controls/Home.ascx.cs` | Dynamic sections by category ID |
| **InfoSection / News** | `InfoSectionDetailRouter`, `Detail2/4/5`, `SectionNews2` | Multiple layouts; router by `InformationTypeID` |
| **Doctor** | `InfoSectionList3`, `InfoSectionDetail3`, `SectionDoctor` | Category 305; URLs `/bac-si/`, `/doi-ngu-chuyen-gia` |
| **Booking** | `Booking.ascx.cs`, `Pages/InfoSection/Booking.aspx` | Telerik RadDatePicker; CMS API; `CRM_Booking` |
| **Chat** | `ChatWidget`, `ChatApi.ashx`, `ChatSearch.ashx`, `chatbot.js` | Strict RAG + OpenAI; logs in `App_Data/ChatLogs` |
| **Search** | `Search.aspx`, `InfoSectionSearchResult` | `/tim-kiem` |
| **Contact** | `LienHe.aspx`, `InfoSectionContact` | Zalo/Messenger from config |
| **Landing** | `LandingView.aspx`, `Landing.Master` | `/tam-duc-page/{slug}` |
| **Newsletter** | `Newsletter.ascx` | `INFO_Newsletter_Insert` |
| **FAQ / Events / Notice** | `SectionFaq`, `SectionEvent`, `SectionNoticeEvent` | Home sections |
| **CBT (Công bố TT)** | `InfoSectionList`, category 374 | Canonical URL rules in router |
| **API/SEO** | `Sitemap.ashx`, `InfoSeoSlug.ashx`, `RssYteApi.ashx` | |
| **Legacy modules** | Advertisement, Comment, PostInfo, Product (ITEM_*) | Still referenced in master SEO paths |

---

## 8. Existing Cursor rules / docs

- **None found** under `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\tam-duc` (no `.cursor/`, no `AGENTS.md`, no `README`)

---

## 9. Web.config key settings (inferred — file missing)

Referenced in code / comments; actual values in absent `Web.config`:

### `DCore.ConfigManager.GetConfig` (via `WebGlobal.cs`, upload, contact)
`SEC_CMS_API`, `DOMAIN_CMS_API`, `WebsiteRoot`, `AdminRoot`, `InformationThumbDirectory`, `InformationPageSize`, `InformationNextPageSize`, `InformationGroupPageSize`, `ImageDirectory`, `EditorDataDirectory`, `EditorImageDirectory`, `ProductThumbDirectory`, `AdvertisementThumbDirectory`, page sizes for Product/Advertisement, `User_Physical_ImagePath`, `User_Logical_ImagePath`, `MaxFileSize_Upload`, `DataFileExtension_Upload`, `PhysicalDirectory_Upload`, `LogicalDirectory_Upload`, `ImageFileExtension_Upload`, `MailTo`, `MailHosting`, `MailSending`, `PassSending`, Advertisement image paths

### `ConfigurationManager.AppSettings`
`Contact_Zalo`, `Contact_Messenger`, `Seo_DefaultShareImage`, `Social_DefaultImage`, `OpenAI_ApiKey`, `OpenAI_Model`, `InfoSeoSlug_ApiKey`, `Advertisement_MaxUploadImageFileSize`, `Advertisement_NoImage`, `Advertisement_ImageFileExtension`, `Advertisement_ImageHeigh/Width`, `System_Logical_IconPath`

### Other config files
- `urlrewrite.config` — URL routing (included in csproj)
- `Web.Debug.config` / `Web.Release.config` — referenced but **not in workspace**

## 10. Report / export libraries

| Library | Status in `his/` |
|---------|-------------------|
| Crystal Reports | **Not found** |
| Aspose | **Not found** |
| RDLC | **Not found** |
| Payoo SDK | Referenced in csproj + resource strings only |
| HtmlAgilityPack | Used in `InfoSectionDetail5.ascx.cs` (HTML parsing) |
| Newtonsoft.Json | Booking API serialize, some detail pages |
| Export | No server-side export pipeline found |

---

## Sample code patterns (for Cursor rules)

**Typical control Page_Load:**
```csharp
protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
{
    if (!IsPostBack)
        LoadData();
}
```

**Typical data load:**
```csharp
var info = new INFO_Information();
DataTable dt = info.GetDataTable("PROC_NAME",
    "@LanguageID", ResManager.CurrentLanguageID,
    "@NodeID", nodeID);
```

**SEO image folder:**
```csharp
string sub = "Information" + ("000000" + infoId).Substring(("000000" + infoId).Length - 6, 6);
return WebGlobal.InformationThumbDirectory + "/" + sub + "/" + image;
```

---

## Gợi ý nhanh cho Cursor rules/skills

1. **Stack lock:** .NET 4.0 WebForms — no async/await, no string interpolation, no modern C#.
2. **No SQL in `.aspx.cs`** — use `InformationWebObject` entities + stored procs via `GetDataTable`.
3. **Language:** always pass `@LanguageID` from `ResManager.CurrentLanguageID`; EN = 2.
4. **URL changes** go in `urlrewrite.config`, not only code-behind.
5. **New hospital UI** → prefer `App_Themes/Default/custom-hos-*.css` with `hos-` prefix.
6. **Booking/chat** → respect external API + `Web.config` keys; never hardcode secrets.
7. **Note missing projects:** rules should say object/service source lives outside `his/` — ask user to open full solution for DAL changes.

Nếu bạn muốn, tôi có thể draft nội dung `.cursor/rules` và một Agent Skill cụ thể từ summary này (cần chuyển sang Agent mode để tạo file).
